name: coursecopilot
description: Your classes inside the AI you already use, free. Share a course in one line.

canvas_base_url.title: Canvas base URL
canvas_base_url.description: Your school's Canvas host, e.g. https://umich.instructure.com. Any Canvas instance works. Prefer `coursecopilot canvas connect` so the token is not stored in a client config.

canvas_token.title: Canvas personal access token
canvas_token.description: Create at Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token. Mapped to CANVAS_TOKEN for the local process only — never written to the CourseCopilot database, packs, or shared configs.
